create.name: WCCM Portugal (Comunidade Portuguesa para a Meditação Cristã)
create.bio:
WCCM Portugal is the Portuguese community of the World Community for Christian Meditation, which in January 2026, on the centenary of John Main's birth, became a formally constituted association in Coimbra. It passes on the contemplative prayer John Main recovered from the early Christian desert tradition: a simple discipline of sitting still, morning and evening, and repeating a prayer word inwardly, so that attention moves from thought to a silent presence.

Meditators meet in groups both in person and online, with online sessions every weekday early in the morning, mid-morning and in the evening, and the community offers introductory courses for newcomers, an annual retreat and weekends on the essential teaching. Its website has recordings of talks, audio tracks with bells and silence for timing a meditation, and a guide to starting the practice. Its YouTube channel publishes Portuguese readings of John Main's talks on the mantra, letting go of distractions and the call to fullness of life.
